proposedOverrides.summary: A misplaced 1000-era atlas polygon tied to the historical Buyid family confederation, whose real centers lay far west and whose rule ended by 1062.

fell.text: The last Buyid branch in Fars fell around 1062 after Baghdad had passed to the Seljuks in 1055.

batchIdentityNotes: Exact target buyid-emirate is indexed circa 1000 to 1100 and was missing a card and override at initial audit.
Its only geometry is world-1000: one Polygon, one ring and 32 positions, bbox 63.600036 to 71.404914 east and 23.675122 to 32.532116 north.
Karachi, Hyderabad in Sindh, Thatta, Sukkur, Khuzdar and Uthal fall inside; every tested historical Buyid center from Baghdad to Kerman falls outside.
The simultaneous buwayhid-emirates MultiPolygon contains the tested Buyid centers. It already maps to the separate buyid-dynasty card and is not added to appliesTo here.
At 1100 the atlas assigns the historical Buyid zone to seljuk-empire. At 1200 it revives buwayhid-emirates and adds buyid-dynasty, both centuries too late.
Historical chronology begins in the 930s, ends Buyid Baghdad in 1055 and ends the last Fars branch around 1062. The 1000 to 1100 interval remains map coverage only.
